instruction: I find dense or distracting information difficult to process. Use `ServiceHoursFormattingReference.txt` on the Desktop as the formatting guide, then simplify the CMS page with URL key `service-hours-draft` without changing its schedule. Set both the page title and content heading to `Service Hours`, rewrite the body using the reference format, enable the page, and save it. Use username `admin` and password `admin1234`.
gt_steps: Open `ServiceHoursFormattingReference.txt` on the Desktop and review its formatting rules.
Sign in to the CMS admin site.
Read the existing body to identify the weekday, Saturday, and Sunday service hours.
Set the page title to `Service Hours`.
Set the content heading to `Service Hours`.

Replace the existing body with `Monday-Friday: 9 AM-5 PM
Saturday: 10 AM-2 PM
Sunday: Closed`, one item per line and in that order.

page.title: Service availability information
page.content: Our representatives answer enquiries Monday through Friday between 9 AM and 5 PM. A shorter service period is available on Saturdays from 10 AM until 2 PM. The desk does not operate on Sundays.
